lines.text: That last-minute goal was so clutch.

data.define: Used when someone does well at an important time.

example.text: That last-minute goal was so clutch.

misuse.text: Don't say 'clutch' about a small purse.
misuse.why: Here it means great under pressure.

data.l1_hook: Bàn thắng phút chót quyết định luôn!
data.l1_ex: Bàn thắng phút chót đó clutch quá.

native.tip: “clutch” = Cứu nguy đúng lúc. Ví dụ: “That last-minute goal was so clutch.”
native.caption:
“clutch” nghĩa là gì?
“clutch” = Cứu nguy đúng lúc.
Ví dụ: “That last-minute goal was so clutch.” (Bàn thắng phút chót đó clutch quá.)
